name: Izu Shaboten Zoo
capybara_experience: Watch capybaras soak in an outdoor hot-spring bath, the original capybara onsen since 1982; winter season runs Nov 21–Apr 4 with fragrant yuzu citrus added to the baths (yuzu bath at the winter solstice); baths prepared daily on weekdays

name: Little Rock Zoo
capybara_experience: See capybaras in the zoo's exhibit — capybaras are returning to the Little Rock Zoo per its April 2026 announcement

name: Buffalo Zoo
capybara_experience: See the zoo's capybara, including male capybara Mozzarella, in the zoo's exhibit

name: Nashville Zoo
capybara_experience: See capybaras at the zoo after Nashville Zoo welcomed capybaras to its collection

name: Capybara Cafe
capybara_experience: Pet giant rodents — visitors can pet capybaras at this new café in Fort Lauderdale's Thrive District
